provenance_note: Thresholds were set after the development and confirmation results of ps_native_v4 were visible and BEFORE the sealed holdout was opened. They encode operational requirements, not the observed values: every ranking threshold sits below the confirmation mean by design, so the gate asks 'is this model usable', not 'did it repeat itself'.

2_temporal_validity.check: protocol folds never reach t42; selection record exp22 exists; confirmation folds not used for selection

3_data_quality.check: feature contract holds on every training and evaluation set; capture contract tests pass

4_ranking_quality.check: confirmation means: nAP >= 0.60, address P@100 >= 0.90, ceiling-normalised R@500 >= 0.75

5_calibration.check: honest per-fold Platt (folds 5-12): mean ECE <= 0.05, max ECE <= 0.10

6_stability.check: fold nAP sd <= 0.20 and no significant downward trend (p < 0.05 with negative slope fails)

7_worst_fold.check: all folds: worst nAP >= 0.40, worst address P@100 >= 0.70

8_slice_performance.check: mean nAP >= 0.50 on first_seen and receiver_only (the majority populations); every other slice reported, any slice mean < 0.30 is a WARNING

9_reproducibility.check: production training reproduces the exp22 per-fold nAP to 1e-9

10_inference_determinism.check: batch invariance and run reproducibility tests pass

11_latency.check: single-row p95 <= 50 ms and >= 10,000 rows/s at 10k-row batches

13_security.check: registry verifies every artifact; console auth and throttle tests pass

14_monitoring.check: model carries a drift reference profile; monitoring tests pass

15_rollback.check: a fallback on the SAME feature schema is registered and verifies

16_artifact_lineage.check: manifest lineage has source commit, code hashes, config hash, raw data hashes, environment, evaluation hash

17_auditability.check: prediction audit log and evidence-class tests pass

18_holdout.check: holdout nAP >= 0.50, address P@100 >= 0.80, ceiling-normalised R@500 >= 0.60, ECE <= 0.10, and nAP >= (worst confirmation-fold nAP - 0.05)
